limits: Lifecycle is separate from model accuracy. Existing geometry, source flags and historical notes are unchanged.
Approval is limited to the stated planning stage; it does not establish a building permit, construction start or completion.
Mixed communities use component status. Do not apply a community-wide construction or approval colour.
The review combines newly checked primary records with dated saved evidence. Unverified physical stages remain qualified.
Previously rendered images retain the status and source dates of their own edition.
Approval includes explicitly qualified approvals in principle and Council-passed amendments. Conditions, site-plan stages and physical delivery remain separate.
Environmental assessment approval is not classified as development approval; the proposed marina retains its separately stated assessment stage.
